2607.17266.title: Debate-on-Graph: Reliable and Adaptive Reasoning of Large Language Model on Uncertain Knowledge Graph
2607.17266.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in natural language processing. However, LLMs often suffer from hallucinations and lack of relevant knowledge when dealing with question answering (QA) tasks. To mitigate these issues, knowledge graphs (KGs) have been utilized to enhance LLM reasoning. Nevertheless, KGs often contain noise and errors, while existing KG-enhanced LLM approaches are generally unable to identify and filter such noisy and erroneous content, which can instead amplify hallucinations and pose challenges for reliable reasoning. Uncertain knowledge graphs (UKGs), which associate each triple with a confidence score to quantify uncertainty, offer a promising direction to address this challenge. Compared with prior work, we investigate how to leverage UKGs to support LLMs for QA. We propose Debate-on-Graph (DoG), a new framework that enables LLMs and UKGs to collaborate adaptively for reliable reasoning. Specifically, we first design a heuristic search algorithm tailored for UKGs to extract reliable and question-relevant subgraphs, thereby reducing noise and errors in retrieved knowledge. We then introduce a Multi-Agent Debate mechanism, which yields reliable answers through adaptive adversarial debates, aiming to fully exploit the knowledge in UKGs while preserving the reliability of retrieved evidence. Extensive experiments on four benchmark QA datasets show that DoG achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing LLM reasoning methods and KG-based baselines, while enabling reliable and adaptive reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/seucoin/Debate-on-Graph.
2607.17266.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在自然語言處理方面展示了卓越的能力。<lb/>然而，LLMs 在處理問題回答（QA）任務時，經常遭遇幻覺和缺乏相關知識的問題。<lb/>為了減輕這些問題，知識圖譜（KGs）被用來增強 LLM 的推理能力。<lb/>然而，KGs 經常包含噪音和錯誤，而現有的 KG 增強 LLM 方法通常無法識別和過濾這些噪音和錯誤內容，反而可能放大幻覺並對可靠推理造成挑戰。<lb/>不確定知識圖譜（UKGs）將每個三元組與置信度分數相關聯，以量化不確定性，為解決這一挑戰提供了一個有前景的方向。<lb/>與先前的工作相比，我們研究如何利用 UKGs 來支持 LLMs 進行 QA。<lb/>我們提出了 Debate-on-Graph（DoG），這是一個新的框架，使 LLMs 和 UKGs 能夠自適應地協作以實現可靠推理。<lb/>具體而言，我們首先設計了一種針對 UKGs 的啟發式搜索算法，以提取可靠且與問題相關的子圖，從而減少檢索知識中的噪音和錯誤。<lb/>然後，我們介紹了一種多代理辯論機制，通過自適應對抗性辯論產生可靠的答案，旨在充分利用 UKGs 中的知識，同時保持檢索證據的可靠性。<lb/>在四個基準 QA 數據集上的廣泛實驗表明，DoG 在現有 LLM 推理方法和基於 KG 的基準上實現了最先進的性能，同時實現了可靠和自適應的推理。<lb/>我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/seucoin/Debate-on-Graph 獲得。
